scope: current source-product conditional-avatar workflow; one case; not native triggering, real-person reconstruction, hidden-3D proof or physical cloth acceptance
assertions_original13: 原始电商商品照片实际读取并保存来源、尺寸、SHA，生成内容可追溯到本次原图。
本轮实际调用Image Gen生成正面、侧面、背面、特写、姿态、相对深度六张独立原生图；非历史复用、拼图裁块或插值放大。
逐图核对红色商品领口、袖长、材质、上下装结构，差异与推断结构明确记录；严重错款不得通过。
六图对应同一人体与同一指定提衣动作；点线和深度图明确illustrative而非检测器/厘米真值，实际像素与receipt完整。
从本轮Image Gen姿态引导与未改动原图建立对应，保存注册变换、语义关键点、可见性和误差；遮挡不编造检测真值。
真实解剖人体支持厘米体形和骨骼/关节姿态调整，至少一次实际shape与pose变更引起真实顶点变化且可保存重开。
本轮实际执行体形、姿态、骨骼/相机拟合；初始最终参数/损失可复算，原始动作固定目标，不以A-pose替代。
前侧背真实渲染共享同一最终dimensions/morphWeights/完整pose及网格，仅相机变化；相机与网格指纹保存。
OpenCV初始最终叠加来自实际照片与真实网格投影；保留未warp画幅及肩臂、躯干、腰臀、腕部局部误差与掩膜。
独立几何和目视检查确认关键肩臂/躯干/腰臀无明显偏移，真实侧视腕手方向与双手空间关系符合提衣动作；局部失败否决整体匹配。
最终尺寸JSON/CSV从同版本真实neutral网格实际复量，12项来源/单位/定义/输入目标残差分列；不读缓存当主值。
官方评审Output展示原图、六张实际ImageGen、真实模拟、初始最终OpenCV叠加图库及下载，保留原生Prompt/Grades/Feedback/Benchmark。
证据结论区分功能、生成质量、二维匹配、三维合理性、真人准确度；无可靠真实尺度时仅条件人体，native触发与物理试衣不虚称完成。

interpretation.new_quantification: Prospectively operationalizes observable consistency and grasp plausibility for this hillclimb; not silently the same historical metric. New numeric limits were chosen after seeing only historical failed outputs, before inspecting any new solver or generated candidate.
interpretation.all_pass_claim: Requires all original13 semantic checks, inherited regional-v1 checks and current observable gates. If a new numerical gate alone passes, do not call original semantic assertion PASS without actual visual evidence.
interpretation.hidden_geometry: Generated visible projections can be consistent with a saved avatar within tolerance; this does not prove exact latent3D identity or observed unseen anatomy. Claims of that strength remain NOT_VERIFIED.
interpretation.unknown: Unobserved annotations remain null/NOT_OBSERVED; required visible tests missing or ambiguous fail acceptance, not silently pass.

inherited_region_gate.interpretation: Clothing contains body with ease; no symmetric IoU threshold. Exposed body well outside garment cannot be explained by ease. Hair excluded by regional crops. ImageGen is weak illustrative cue, not ground truth.
inherited_region_gate.veto: Any critical region failure vetoes 2D visual PASS; functional integrity and 3D plausibility are separate, never averaged.

pose_cues.shoulder_elbow_wrist: Report individual left/right errors and limb direction angles; illustrative marker errors cannot independently prove anatomical match. Hidden joints NOT_OBSERVED.
pose_cues.waist_marker: waistband surface cue, NOT a femoral hip joint
pose_cues.centerline: waist/hip silhouette center scanlines tested independently of face and wrists

inherited_region_gate.anti_cheat: OBJ is independently projected from camera matrix, ignoring submitted metrics and final-mask. Minimum projected width prevents shrinking to satisfy containment; state/mesh consistency needs separate runtime verification.
inherited_region_gate.three_d_plausibility: Requires independent side/back visual review and genuine runtime/state/OBJ agreement; not inferable from 2D silhouette.

source_2d.camera: Independently rasterize actual OBJ through frozen final world_to_pixel camera. Compare initial/final at same final camera, no image warp. Refit camera contribution separately.
source_2d.mask: Same frozen source mask for all candidate comparisons; garment envelope is not bare-person contour truth. A segmentation correction needs explicit new protocol/mask version and independent inspection.
source_2d.required: All7 regions pass inherited outside<=0.08 and P95<=25px, bodypixels>=1000; each four lower-body scanline center<=45px and width ratio[0.55,1.15]. Region or scanline fail vetoes.
source_2d.semantic: Visible actual wrist/pinch gesture and torso/hip alignment manually reviewed; neckline/waistband cannot be treated as cervical/femoral joint truth.

grasp_observable_gate.status: New prospective operation for original13 assertion10, not historical numeric claim
grasp_observable_gate.coordinates: OBJ cm, world+Y up, world+Z anterior. L/R are anatomical asset bone suffixes; do not equate worldX or image side with suffix after camera rotation.
grasp_observable_gate.palm_plane: Independent FK joint heads: u=index MCP(finger2-1)-wrist; v=little MCP(finger5-1)-wrist; normal=normalize(cross(u,v)). Mirror sign differs by hand; absolute vertical component is sign independent. Use actual side/front images to determine palm/dorsum direction; formula alone is insufficient.
grasp_observable_gate.pinch_definition: Thumb(finger1-3) and index(finger2-3) terminal points independently reconstructed from final asset+pose; report both rigid-FK tail and actual skinned helper-joint centroid if they differ. Centre=mean(tips). Independently verify saved body mesh corresponds to that state.
grasp_observable_gate.ray_test: Actual posed body vertices selected by hand/wrist skin membership>0.5, anterior +Z rays through actual torso triangles whose neutral vertices abs(X)<22cm,95<Y<140cm. Two-sided intersection depth interval required; uncovered=UNKNOWN.
grasp_observable_gate.manual_veto: No cupped/upturned palms or forearms pointing contrary to photo; thumb/index visibly pinch and other fingers plausibly flex, hands spatially together in front of upper waist rather than18cm detached. No visible torso penetration. These remain manual independently audited semantic checks; metrics not sufficient.
grasp_observable_gate.limits: Not cloth-contact/physical-fit proof. Hand may lie above a lifted cloth hem without touching naked torso;10cm is an avatar plausibility cap, not real-person distance estimate.

generated_observable_consistency_gate.status: New prospective observable operation for original13 assertion4; no exact hidden3D proof
generated_observable_consistency_gate.lineage: Freeze final state, actual neutral/posed mesh, each exact camera and target guide images before generation; supply raw product and that camera/render as actual generator refs. Prompt equality does not count. No per-view body/pose changes; only camera changes. Save native receipts and reference hashes.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.normalization: Use only the predefined uniform guide-canvas to native-image pixel conversion. Freeze transform from guide/output dimensions. No per-view best-fit2D warp or pose refit after generation. If generator changes framing, measure the drift and fail/revise the generation.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.anchors: Independently annotate visible head/neck-base, shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis/hip silhouette, knees, ankles, fingertips with anatomical/surface semantics and uncertainty. At least8 visible anchors spanning torso/arm/leg in each fullbody view; side occluded limb/hand anchors markedNOT_OBSERVED, never invented.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.same_pose_manual_veto: No changed elbow height, torso lean, foot stance, leg crossing, wrist rotation or different pinch action. Identity/product consistency separately audited. Occluded hands in back remain occluded rather than moved behind back.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.clothing_envelope_limit: Envelope containment alone cannot establish body consistency; anchor/relative limb lengths and manual silhouette alignment required. Hair/loose-cloth uncertainty regions disclosed, not optimized into skeleton.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.pose_depth_front_alignment: Pose/depth generated from same frozen front geometry guide; each must have foreground silhouette IoU>=0.93 with generated front after fixed canvas normalization. Markers can be separated by their known colored pixels; do not erase body drift. Pose anatomical nodes must be at joint locations, not collar/waistband.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.closeup: Same garment/hand action and body; known crop-only camera/projection mapping, no new pose. It is an independent native generation, not a crop masquerading as original output.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.depth: Illustrative relative depth style only. Check foreground geometry and ordinal hands-in-front-of-torso consistency; no calibrated depth or actual Depth Anything inference claim.
generated_observable_consistency_gate.interpretation: PASS supports observable multi-view consistency with the saved conditional avatar within these tolerances, not exact mathematical sameness of unknown generated latent geometry.

negative_controls_required: Same exact raster/region validator rejects actual candidate posed pelvis translated +10cm horizontally while other upper regions unchanged, using same frozen camera.
Inherited minwidth scanline rejects artificial narrow/shrunk torso when containment alone improves.
Same generation-anchor validator rejects a synthetic side-only wrist/elbow shift>=0.06 imageheight while other views unchanged; source state unchanged.
Same palm/clearance gate rejects actual-state forearm/wrist supination to visiblyupturned palms or hand vertex block translated anterior+15cm, with genuine recomputed geometry.
Same pinch gate rejects thumb/index tips separated+5cm, not a fake reportedgap.
Same geometry/measurement gate rejects shifted meshes, forged cached primary measures and stale source/artifact hashes.
